text:
maria_sales: Quick update from the Lynx POC today. We ran baseline hosted at 9am PT, then a Dedicated run at 11am. Customer goal: sustain 180-220 QPS, p95 <= 2s, encryption-at-rest with their KMS. They asked for a cost ballpark ~ $3k for the engagement.

Tanya_SE: Nice. Can you paste the final perf numbers? Also did they confirm non-streaming responses and no prefix caching?

maria_sales: Confirmed non-streaming, prefix cache OFF. Hosted baseline (1h sustain window): sustained QPS ~195, p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 930ms, error rate 0.12%. Observed occasional tail jitter aligned with node GC.

Sam_Eng: Dedicated run details: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs, model pinned: redwood-open-large-v1 (L4x quantized). Warmup 20m, ramp 8m, sustain 60m. Client load split across 3 generator VMs. Results (sustain window): sustained QPS 205, p50 70ms, p95 160ms, p99 300ms, errors 0.02%. Token burn ~ 42k tokens/s.

Sam_Eng: Short CSV of per-minute p95 during sustain (minute,p95_ms):
```
60,158
61,162
62,155
63,170
64,159
65,160
```

Otto_SRE: Key infra notes: Dedicated pool prevented cross-tenant interference; autoscaler stayed idle during sustain. We saw small spikes when batch sizing auto-adjusted under burst; recommend fixing batch_size=4 for consistent latency.

Sam_Eng: Cost breakdown for the Dedicated run (estimates):
- GPU runtime (2 GPUs * 1.5 hours total including warmup/ramp/sustain): ~2 * 1.5 * $X/hr = $Y
- Network + egress negligible (same region testing) ~ $Z
- Platform usage / orchestration + temporary reserved nodes surcharge = $W
Estimated total for the run ~ $2.8k - $3.4k depending on exact GPU SKU and discount. If they accept hosted baseline only the cost would be ~ $700 but with higher latency variance.

maria_sales: Good — that maps to their $3k target if we use Dedicated. They asked about KMS/HSM: they require customer-managed KMS (OK for hosted/dedicated). If they later insist on HSM-backed keys we must move to Private and that'll add setup + license.

security-bot: Note: CMK via AWS/GCP KMS is supported for Hosted & Dedicated. HSM-only keys require Private and separate attestation. See security playbook doc: https://intranet.redwood/security/kms-hsm.

Tanya_SE: Action items: 1) I'll attach full JTL logs + graphs for both runs, 2) Sam will push the exact load script and docker image for their perf team, 3) Maria to send the pricing note and ask if they want Dedicated contract (monthly commit) vs one-off engagement.

Sam_Eng: Pushed artifacts to the shared folder: /shared/lynx/poc-artifacts/6009990000/. Load command (wrk-compatible):
```
./loadgen --target 205 --concurrency 220 --duration 68m --ramp 8m \\
  --payload-file sample_prompts.json --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"
```

maria_sales: I'll include the artifacts in the email and propose two options: 
A) One-off Dedicated engagement for the POC (price ~ $3.2k)
B) Hosted baseline + option to upgrade to Dedicated for production (lower upfront, higher variance).

Otto_SRE: One operational note for production: enable minimal autoscaler headroom (10-15%) to avoid cold-starts during microbursts; use pinned model variant and kernel profile L4x-8bit + fixed batch_size=4 for best p95 stability.

maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll send the summary to Lynx now and copy the perf artifacts. Will update thread if they ask for HSM or longer soak. :thumbsup:
